full_page.content:
1931, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 10 Cont.
Dec. 23 Smith case - divorce .....?! Alique sickly ... to New Mexico.
Young Man .. blood-poisoned finger - Dr. must amputate to-morrow if ..
Mrs. Cunningham ... cancer of breast - going away .... Aliqua ... nerveous
Dec. 24 Carl Hunt - 45 - a convert away from home near two yrs. - drinks - discouraged ... enrolled To-day perpetually
Pneumonia. Rob't Huebner - 6 - has Pneu .- 4 days high fever - hem- oraging since last evening. Mother sick too - are enrolled - per- petually.
Page 11
Dec. 26 Carmel Wagner - 30 - T.B. - Chicago - McDonough's niece. Joseph McDon. - Threatened T.B.
Dec. 27 Ronald Perfette - 12 - operated 3 times tonsils, etc. No better is enrolled To-day.
Mrs. Mary Hirsch - 27 - of Pontiac - threatened with cancer of breast - serious trouble with her limbs. Doctors can do nothing - Goes daily to Holy Communion - making nervous
Henry Duprey - 64 - Erysipelas, quite "hopeless", enrolled at 1:45P.M. Gladys Reaume ( 595 King Ave.) gifted girl - cures ... thru her -
asked to have hands blest.
Dec. 19 Delia Jibulo - 57 - threatened mental break-down .... Geo. Lavely - 26 - non-suffering from a traveling abcess ... Eczema from Marine City & mother of 12 Joseph Salvona - running ears
Page 12 Dec. 30 Mrs. Rose Lavolva - 58 - in auto crash - badly hurt - ask prayers.
